title: Memory
description: One thing an AI assistant should remember about the person it works for. The Markdown body is the memory itself.

name.description: Short kebab-case identifier for the memory, unique in the collection.

description.description: One line saying what the memory is about, specific enough to decide from it alone whether to read it.

kind.description: user: who the person is. feedback: how they want assistants to work. project: ongoing work, goals and dates. reference: where to find things.

by.description: The assistant that saved or last changed the memory, such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex.
